Commentary: Blessing Muzarabani to Ikram Alikhil, no run, short of length and down leg, Ikram Alikhil flicks and misses. Taken to his right by Tafadzwa Tsiga
Jayaraman Madanagopal takes a lightmeter reading and he tells Bennett that no more pacers. So back to spin and it's the leggie - Maskesa.
Vincent Masekesa [9.0-4-20-1] is back into the attack

Vincent Masekesa to Afsar Zazai, SIX, begins with a half-tracker on middle, Afsar Zazai goes on the back foot and pulls over deep mid-wicket. When it's short like that, easy for the batter and Vincent Masekesa is welcomed back with a six
Vincent Masekesa to Afsar Zazai, no run, tossed up full outside off, Afsar Zazai gets forward to defend
Vincent Masekesa to Afsar Zazai, no run, tossed up full on off, Afsar Zazai gets forward to defend to the left of Vincent Masekesa
Vincent Masekesa to Afsar Zazai, no run, tossed up full on middle, another forward defence, to the short mid-wicket area
A slip and a forward short-leg.
Vincent Masekesa to Afsar Zazai, no run, tad quicker, good length and turns from leg to middle, Afsar Zazai goes on the back foot to defend
Vincent Masekesa to Afsar Zazai, no run, tossed up full on middle, a forward defence to cover
Wessly Madhevere [1.0-0-4-0] is back into the attack

Wessly Madhevere to Ikram Alikhil, 1 run, tossed up full on leg-stump, from round the wicket with a slip and a gully, and a silly-point in. Ikram Alikhil gets forward to flick to the vacant mid-wicket area
Should be the last over of the day. Artificial lights on. Afsar Zazai meanwhile pulls out as Wessly Madhevere delivers. The batter not ready. A slip and a forward short-leg for the right-hander.
Wessly Madhevere to Afsar Zazai, no run, slower and turns into middle, good length and Afsar Zazai goes on the back foot to defend to forward short-leg
Wessly Madhevere to Afsar Zazai, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Afsar Zazai comes down the track and drives to long-on
Wessly Madhevere to Ikram Alikhil, no run, good length on leg-stump, Ikram Alikhil goes on the back foot and nudges it to square leg
The silly-point has moved to forward short-leg for Ikram Alikhil.
Wessly Madhevere to Ikram Alikhil, no run, quicker and good length on leg-stump, Ikram Alikhil goes on the back foot and turns it to backward square leg

Wessly Madhevere to Ikram Alikhil, 2 runs, dragged down on off, Ikram Alikhil goes on the back foot and pulls between mid-wicket and mid-on. They come back for the 2nd and Jayaraman Madanagopal flicks the bails off. That will be stumps
